L4.falha_pt: Ataque à pessoa e apelo ao ridículo: estranheza não é erro, e o teste justo é aplicar o mesmo cenário a humanos e examinar a premissa

en.frase: Sentientists are even crazier than vegans
formas: Vegans were already hard to put up with, now there are sentientists
A sentientist is a vegan who lost their mind
This is veganism taken to delirium
en.falha: Attack on the person and appeal to ridicule: strangeness is not error, and the fair test is to apply the same scenario to humans and examine the premise

motivos.O rótulo aplicado aos veganos é estendid: The label applied to vegans is extended to those who go further
motivos.A estranheza da posição sobre os insetos: The strangeness of the position on insects becomes an accusation
motivos.A caricatura do sencientista vira prova: The caricature of the sentientist becomes proof of excess
motivos.O exagero atribuído a uns prejudicaria a: The excess attributed to some would harm the cause
motivos.O radicalismo é atribuído ao movimento i: Radicalism is attributed to the whole movement
